# Tuesday 13/10/2026

Pablo sent us the script for the segmentation in StarDist as a extension of QuPath. 
I installed it with the menu of manage extensions. There, there are defined scripts depending on the image type you have. In our case, it is a H&E 3 channels, RGB. 
I downloaded the pre-trained model from the git hub they give, and run the script with the parameters Pablo sent (script_nucleus_segmentation.groovy). 

````{groovy}
def stardist = StarDist2D.builder(modelPath)
    .threshold(0.15)
    .normalizePercentiles(0.1, 99.9)
    .pixelSize(0.25)
    .measureShape()
    .measureIntensity()
    .build()
````

Also, I cropped the image of the samples 7 and 8, with the script crop_tissue.py. 

At the same time I did the alignment of the tiff image and the cytoassist of the samples 1 and 2.

# Wednesday 14/10/2026

The run of StarDist extension finished, but in my opinion, there were more detections than real nucleus in the image. So I tried modifying the parameters, the threshold, and the pixel size. 

````{groovy}
def stardist = StarDist2D
    .builder(modelPath)
    .normalizePercentiles(0.1, 99.9) // Percentile normalization
    .threshold(0.3)              // Probability (detection) threshold
    .pixelSize(0.5)              // Resolution for detection
    .measureShape()              // Add shape measurements
    .measureIntensity()          // Add nucleus measurements
    .build()
````	 

This time, the run lasted 25 min, compared to the 5 hours of the last one. And the number of detections increased almost the double comparing to the results of SpaceRanger.

**Num Detections	287311**

Although the number is better, I think we can improve even more the detections. There are still nucleus that StarDist is not capturing 

````{groovy}
def stardist = StarDist2D
    .builder(modelPath)
    .normalizePercentiles(0.1, 99.9) // Percentile normalization
    .threshold(0.25)              // Probability (detection) threshold
    .pixelSize(0.5)              // Resolution for detection
    .measureShape()              // Add shape measurements
    .measureIntensity()          // Add nucleus measurements
    .build()
````

It finished in 25 minutes too, and the total number of detections is: 
**Num Detections	330585**

Now, I'm going to launch SpaceRanger with custom segmentations to see the metrics of both geojson. The first hypothesis is than we would have improved de UMIs in cells a 40% (from 43% to aprox. 80%). And in the second, if the improvement is not notorious, the the major detections would be noise.

````{bash}

````

# Thursday 15/10/2026

All the jobs finished, but in the case of TMA_3_4 with the custom alignments, the image and the fiducial alignments were from the complete image. Also, there was a problem with the cluster, the big square was showed as an object, and SR asigned to it a cluster. To solve this, I reloaded the mask in QuPath, removed this square and with the selector I draw all the sample, selecting all te polygons corresponding to nucleus. 
Finally, I launched again the jobs but with the correct files
